description: Toggles quiz mode (grading with points) and/or the email collection mode. Quiz mode only enables grading — points, correct answers and feedback are set per question afterwards via update_question with the questionItem.question.grading mask (add_question cannot set them). email_collection_type: DO_NOT_COLLECT, VERIFIED (respondent must be signed in; email verified) or RESPONDER_INPUT (respondent types an email). At least one field is required; only the provided fields are touched.

form_id.description: The form id — the long id from the form URL (docs.google.com/forms/d/<formId>/edit) or from create_form output.

is_quiz.description: Turn quiz mode on/off (enables per-question grading).

name: update_form_settings
title: Update form settings
